about: Human players (issue #21, open and undiagnosed, a diagnosis tool): 'Patrols after Gilnid did not register for aggro ... the party and tank stayed OOC eating while I took them down slowly'. The post-Gilnid tunnel patrols are native waypoint walkers: Overseer 79361 leading Wizard 79260 (formation, path 793610), and Evoker 79360 (path 793600). Both loop from (-107,-649) up to the foundry exit at (-144,-580). The party starts on their path (path 793610 point 6), the foundry trash pre-cleared as 3daca820 does. Lead suspect, from code only: DcLeaderSignal.cpp AnyGroupMemberInCombat never counts the human, so a human-only fight arms no party assist, and a PatrolHold verdict may also keep the tank parked. Read the trace with lab_trace --actions Tank for which one it was. Not staged: the report has the party resting (eating/drinking) when the patrol walks in, and staging tops everyone up, so a rest-gated cause is not exercised here.
